full_prompt_en: An early twentieth-century decorative color print presents a young woman wearing a broad pale hat heavy with cream and muted peach flowers. She turns slightly toward the viewer, her head inclined and her calm blue-gray eyes meeting the gaze directly. Soft dark brown curls spread to either side beneath the hat, and a single slender earring drops beside her long neck. A deep sage-green dress with an off-shoulder line and narrow lace edge enters from the lower left. Behind the hat, dark green leaves and floral stems form a dense upper canopy, while the rest of the background falls away into flecked warm cream paper. Slim vertical rules on both sides make a quiet ornamental frame. The face is rendered with smooth pale peach wash, faint pink cheeks, a little rusty red at the lips, and fine dark lines around the eyes; hair and leaves are built from broader, almost flat shapes with ink contours and small interior hatching. The printing surface shows tan speckles, uneven ink density, and gentle wear, making the smooth face stand out against the aged ground. Light is soft and even, with a narrow shadow under the brim and at the jaw rather than dramatic modeling. The central face sits below the weight of the flowered arc, and a long ribbon descends on the right to echo the border. The composition feels elegant, intimate, and carefully balanced between graphic pattern and delicate observation.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅二十世纪初的装饰彩色版画呈现一位戴宽大浅色帽的年轻女子，帽上压着奶油色与暗桃色花朵。她稍稍转向观者，头微倾，平静的蓝灰眼睛直视前方。柔软深棕卷发从帽下向两边展开，一枚纤长耳饰垂在修长颈旁。深鼠尾草绿连衣裙带有露肩线条与细窄蕾丝边，从左下方进入画面。帽后深绿叶片和花枝组成密集上部冠幅，其余背景淡为带斑点的暖奶油纸。两侧细竖线形成安静的装饰边框。面部以平滑浅桃色罩染、微粉双颊、少量锈红嘴唇和眼周细暗线描出；头发与叶片则由更宽、近乎平面的色形、墨线轮廓和小块内部排线构成。印刷表面可见棕点、油墨浓淡不均与轻微磨损，使平滑面容从旧纸底上凸显。光柔软而均匀，帽檐下和下颌边只有狭窄阴影，不作戏剧化塑形。中央面容处在花弧重量之下，右侧垂下的长缎带呼应边框。构图优雅亲密，在平面图案与细腻观察之间谨慎取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: Early decorative color printmaking combines delicate ink contour, smooth translucent color wash, and broad nearly flat ornamental masses on visibly aged cream paper. Deep sage and dark olive areas carry visual weight against pale peach, ivory, and muted blush, with tiny rusty red accents. Fine interior hatching adds selective detail, while larger leaf-like shapes remain graphic and simplified. A dense curved cluster across the upper field can balance a quieter open lower area, with slim vertical border rules and a trailing line giving the page an elegant cadence. Soft even illumination creates slight overlap shadows instead of strong chiaroscuro. Tan freckles, worn ink, and uneven printed color stay visible across the surface, contrasting with carefully softened central tonal transitions. Contours are precise around important features but loosen in background pattern. The resulting image is intimate, poised, and ornamental, with an old lithographic or hand-colored poster character rather than glossy digital polish.
style_prompt_zh: 早期装饰彩色版画把精细墨线轮廓、平滑透明色彩罩染与大块近乎平面的纹饰色形结合，印在明显陈旧的奶油纸上。深鼠尾草绿和暗橄榄色对浅桃、象牙白与低饱和粉红构成重量，点以微小锈红。细密内部排线选择性增加细节，较大的叶形仍保持图像化和简化。上部密集弧形簇可平衡下方较安静的开放空间，细竖边框与一条垂落的线赋予页面优雅节拍。柔和均匀的照明只造成轻微叠压阴影，而非强烈明暗对照。棕色纸斑、磨损墨迹与印色不均在表面持续可见，与中央精心柔化的调子过渡形成对比。重要部位轮廓精确，背景图案中则逐渐松开。成像亲密、镇定而富于装饰性，带旧石印或手工上色海报质感，没有亮滑数字修饰。
theme_en: A young woman wearing a flower-trimmed hat in an ornamental print
theme_zh: 装饰版画中戴花饰宽檐帽的年轻女子
name: Raphael Kirchner
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
